name: CentralLangLinks
author: Hitchwiki
description: Centralised interlanguage links for the Hitchwiki language family. A single shared table (page_translations) maps a concept, keyed by its English page title, to the page title in every other language. The LanguageLinks hook renders the sidebar from that table instead of from per-page [[xx:Title]] wikitext, so a translation set is edited in exactly one place with English as the ground truth.
